title: QUIC RFC 9368 Version Information Parse-Failure Close Work Item
summary: Close the RFC 9368 parse-failure gap by mapping malformed peer Version Information to a transport-parameter parse-failure fatal marker and proving the connection runtime closes locally with TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR.
planned_changes:
- Distinguish malformed QUIC transport-parameter parsing from generic TLS transcript parse failures.
- Map the transport-parameter parse-failure marker to QUIC TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR in the transport-facing TLS bridge.
- Add focused RFC 9368 requirement-home tests for non-four-byte-aligned and too-short Version Information values.
- Remove the explicit RFC9368-S4-P3-S2-R01 gap entry and refresh generated coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run the focused RFC9368-S4-P3-S2-R01 requirement-home tests, run the RFC 9368 requirement-home suite, validate SpecTrace JSON, refresh generated QUIC requirement coverage triage, and run `git diff --check`.
out_of_scope: Changing Version Information encoding rules beyond classifying parser failures.
